documents.title: System Architecture & Philosophy
documents.text: The Hugo-Carbon platform is built upon zero-dependency resilience, progressive enhancement, and non-blocking background Web Workers. It incorporates Web Crypto AES-256-GCM, WebGPU on-device WebLLM, and IBM Carbon v11 Design System tokens.

documents.title: Build-Time Encryption & Access Control
documents.text: Pages declaring password in front matter are encrypted during the post-build pipeline using PBKDF2 with 100,000 SHA-256 iterations and AES-256-GCM. Plaintext is purged from static HTML and decrypted in-browser via Web Crypto crypto.subtle.

documents.title: Multithreaded Background Workers
documents.text: CPU-intensive processes run in isolated Web Workers. The 60Hz physics engine uses zero-copy Float32Array ArrayBuffer transferables, Stockfish UCI chess calculates moves with alpha-beta search, and the SPSS worker performs tabular analytics.

documents.title: W3C CSVW Interactive Data Table System
documents.text: The CSVW engine parses raw CSV datasets with W3C JSON metadata schemas. It renders IBM Carbon DataTables with live search, column sorting, pagination, and status tag formatting.

documents.title: WCAG 2.2 AA Accessibility & Web Speech
documents.text: The platform strictly complies with WCAG 2.2 Level AA guidelines, featuring skip-to-content links, focus-visible contrast rings, prefers-reduced-motion media query adaptations, and a native window.speechSynthesis read-aloud engine.
